title: Freshora Agro
description: An export catalogue for Freshora Agro, presenting fruit and vegetables through a consistent green-and-earth-tone page system. The work shown is catalogue and page design, not a claim of creating every product or certification featured inside.
challenge: Make a varied produce range easy to browse while giving product photography and specification tables room to work.
solution: Product spreads pair close-up photography with structured tables, curved fields of green and repeated brand details.
results: A supplied catalogue design with a cover, company page and produce-range spreads.
